item.tib: gsang sngags yid bzhin nor bu las bza' btung tshogs 'khor bzhugs rnal 'byor bon spyod bcu gsum gral nas dge'o
item.coloph: gcod gdams rin chen phreng ba yi/ lam khyer zas tshogs bon spyod 'di/ rig 'dzin stong rgyung mthu chen gyis/ drung mu ha ra bdag la gdams/ mu 'bung nam 'od zhus nas brgyud/ bkra shis/ zhal dro/ dge'o//
